environment.build_command: cargo build --locked --release --features embedded-migrations -p hubuum -p hubuum-scale-benchmark --bin hubuum-admin --bin hubuum-scale-benchmark
environment.binary_source_note: Release binaries built from cd2f0389; later changes affect the Python harness, documentation and host/VM clock assertions in tests.
environment.interrupted_attempt: The initial local attempt stopped after six retained repeats because its verifier incorrectly rejected kernel memory.peak above memory.max; partial results and log are retained separately. The corrected complete matrix starts with fresh fixtures.

qualification.method: Five fresh database copies for each workload and profile; all repeats retained.
qualification.candidate_scope: Returned task index entries and sequential task rows per scheduler call, including repeated visits and empty calls; internal B-tree comparisons and heap-chain traversal are not counted.
qualification.instrumentation: Fixture wrapper calls unchanged production function; counter collection and recorder insert are included in claim latency and lock occupancy.
qualification.host_activity: Task-owned compilation and correctness tests completed before measurements. The shared buildkit container was the only other running container at measurement start; normal desktop activity continued.

manifest.warmup: 100 excluded claims per process for immediate runs; a separate 30-second warm-up window before timed runs
